lines.zh: 我四足着地，头压得很低
lines.en: On all fours, my head hangs low.

lines.zh: 体重把河岸的泥压实了
lines.en: My weight packs the riverbank mud.

lines.zh: 我沿着悬崖边的林带走
lines.en: I walk the treeline along the cliff.
The redwood trunks are thicker than I am.
Step by step, I land solidly.
I walk on the outer edge of the herd.
The crest ridges over my snout.
I barge through low trees.
Bank gravel gives way under me.
Alone, I am more wary.
I tear whole patches of grass.
My forelegs are shorter than my hind legs.
I step slowly over a fallen trunk.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看看林间空隙
lines.en: I raise my head and check the gap in the trees.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫动，赶走虫子
lines.en: My tail swishes at the flies.
Head down grazing, I also listen.
The herd is near; I am at ease.

lines.zh: 我鼻梁上的冠在光下发暗
lines.en: My crest looks dark in the light.
I chew a long time before swallowing.
Old bark-stripping marks on the trunk.
I stand very still; I dislike moving.

lines.zh: 我时常看一眼林子深处
lines.en: I keep glancing into the deep woods.
Fresh prints underfoot.

lines.zh: 这一片草够我们吃几天
lines.en: This grass will feed us for days.
I scratch my neck with a hind leg.
A shadow shifts among the trees.
Wind rustles the leaves.

lines.zh: 我回头看看有没有小的跟上
lines.en: I look back to see if the young are following.
I raise my head, snout low.

lines.zh: 群体在后面，我挡在前面
lines.en: The herd is behind; I stand in front.
Back off and I will let you pass.
You are no predator.
Four blocks tall, and meaner when alone.
You smell of tree resin.

lines.zh: 这里到河边都是我们的地
lines.en: From here to the river is ours.
You may stand, but do not approach.
That hit my hind leg.
I sway, then steady.
Thick hide absorbed some of it.
I lower my head to guard my neck.
Blood shows clearly on the mud.
It is not yet time for me to fall.
Pain makes me meaner.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向顶了一下
lines.en: I butt toward your direction.
Leaves suit me best.
That branch is too thin.
I lower my head; one bite and it is gone.
Conifer needles would be better.
I will not eat your hand.
Step back and I will eat.
This bite is tender.
The young eat first.
I chew slowly; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 这根枝条叶太少，再来一捆。
lines.en: Too few leaves on that branch — bring another bundle.
One turn of my flank crowds you out.
What you hit is solid.
That stopped me for half a step.
My foot leaves a pit.
You should go around more widely.
Our collision splashes mud.
I dislike being shoved.
I lift a foot and shift it away.
Simply get behind a tree.

lines.zh: 你用肩顶我，我退了半步
lines.en: You shoulder into me and I give half a step.
Alone, I am not to be trifled with.
She takes the front; I take the back.
The young walk between us.
If I spot a predator, I call.
We warn each other.
There is grass enough; no need to fight.
The riverbank is where we often go.
Together we have nothing to fear.
We hold the same forest.
My family walks along the river.
I lower my head and touch it.
Not grass; I will not eat it.

lines.zh: 我够不着这么低的东西
lines.en: I cannot reach anything that low.
There is no smell to it.
I push it aside with my snout.

lines.zh: 掉在路上的东西会绊人
lines.en: Things in the path trip people.
I could carry that weight.
You take it; I will step aside.

lines.zh: 我不需要这个，地狱溪的蕨叶够了。
lines.en: I do not need that; Hell Creek ferns suffice.
Do not stand directly in front of me.
I am alone, and short-tempered.
I lower my snout, ready to charge.
The herd watches from behind.
First comes a warning.
Three steps back and there is no trouble.
The crest on my snout is a weapon.
I have held this forest a long while.
I lift a forefoot.
I count to two.
I keep to the trees so you cannot circle.
If you retreat, I follow.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很重，你能听见
lines.en: My steps are heavy; you can hear them.
The clearing is narrow.
I press in from your flank.
The cliff is behind you.

lines.zh: 我的同伴堵住了另一头
lines.en: My companions block the other end.
Head low, I aim the crest at you.

lines.zh: 你退的每一步我都算过
lines.en: I have counted every step you take back.

lines.zh: 树脂的味道会沾在你身上
lines.en: The resin smell clings to you.
I do not wish to chase far.
I called and a companion answered.
Do you hear the forest moving?
I butt with my snout crest.
A forefoot presses down.
I shove you from the side.

lines.zh: 四格高的鸭嘴龙，群里才温和。
lines.en: Gentle only with the herd.
I turn and the tail sweeps round.

lines.zh: 我从红杉林里抬起前腿。
lines.en: I rear up out of the redwood grove.
You are still up; again.
Mud churns under us.
I check my force to shield the young.
That landed on your shield.
Breathing hard, still standing.
I come out of the redwood stand.
Dew bends the riverside grass.
First I check toward the cliff.
Nobody in the clearing.
My prints sink deep in the mud.
The herd is in the distant shade.
Pine resin in the air.
I shake the water off my snout.
I back into the clearing.
A fallen trunk snaps underfoot.
I raise my head for the tallest tree.
Alone today.
The river's smell is clear.
I slip down the cliff edge.
Water reaches my chest and I cannot stand.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推倒在一棵树旁
lines.en: The blast throws me against a tree.
Something sticks in my flank.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我四肢发沉
lines.en: That force makes my limbs heavy.
Starving, I chew bark.

lines.zh: 雷落在林子里，我全身一震
lines.en: Lightning strikes the forest and I convulse.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我什么也踩不到
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; nothing to stand on.
